# ADD-GP

### Official implementation for Few-Shot Speech Deepfake Detection Adaptation with Gaussian Processes
#### Interspeech 2025
Recent advancements in Text-to-Speech (TTS) models, particularly in voice cloning, have intensified the demand for adaptable and efficient deepfake detection methods. As TTS systems continue to evolve, detection models must be able to efficiently adapt to previously unseen generation models with minimal data.
